evidence.notes: Intransitive in all listed senses: to walk, and of a device or plan, to work (le moteur marche, ça marche).
Transitive montrer quelque chose (to show something) and ditransitive montrer quelque chose à quelqu'un, the construction given in the usage note.
Takes a direct object in all senses: observer un phénomène (watch/notice) and observer une règle (comply with a rule).
Transitive pencher quelque chose (to tilt something), as the usage note states, and intransitive pencher (le tableau penche = to lean/hang to one side).
Direct-object construction in the documented senses: an insect stings or a sharp object pricks someone/something (piquer quelqu'un, piquer un doigt).
